documents.title: ADR-0048: RabbitMQ and unified Go workers replace Media

properties.recorded_status:
Accepted, 2026-08-31.

Implementation note, 5 September 2026: unified Go/RabbitMQ source has replaced Node Media.
The temporary file-publication path currently bypasses upload inspection; the inspection

documents.title: ADR-0049: GitHub-triggered production deploys

properties.recorded_status:
Proposed, 2026-09-25. Nothing in this record is implemented: no deploy workflow, runner, deploy
key or Cloudflare Access application exists, and none may be added until an owner accepts one
option below.

documents.title: ADR-0050: Companion structure tools compile declarative specs in the user's client

properties.recorded_status:
Accepted, 2026-09-25. The owner accepted the decision below and every recommended default in
"Owner decisions". Implemented on `main` as of 2026-10-08 through the consult phase: the chat
and consult tool catalogs, `packages/structure-spec`, the blueprint tools and the plan preview in
the companion panel. The per-phase gates and the [SEC] reviews listed under Security are not
recorded here as done.

documents.title: ADR-0051: Core-owned scheduling, notifications, reminders and automations

properties.recorded_status:
Accepted by the architect 2026-09-29 for implementation on `feature/life-os`. Owner
decisions still open are listed at the end; each defaults as written until the owner says
otherwise. [SEC] surfaces are marked and each needs the security review before its phase merges.

documents.title: ADR-0052: Two-way Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook sync

properties.recorded_status:
Accepted by the architect 2026-09-29 for implementation on `feature/life-os`. The
owner asked for Google and Outlook on 2026-09-29, which supersedes the 2026-08-02 cut of Outlook in
`todo.md`. [SEC] throughout: OAuth, stored refresh tokens and outbound calls need security review.
Live proof needs owner-created provider apps (see Owner steps).

documents.title: ADR-0053: Installed-app shell and local body copies

properties.recorded_status:
Proposed, 2026-09-29. The change it describes is on `main` as of 2026-10-08 (`apps/web/src/pwa`,
`apps/web/src/launch`, `apps/web/src/editor/body-cache.ts`, the service worker). Recording the
owner's acceptance in this status line is still owed.

documents.title: ADR-0054: Container view arrangement - applied filters, several sorts, wider grouping, summaries

properties.recorded_status:
Accepted, 2026-10-01, by the owner. Proposed the same day; the change it describes was built on
`feature/views-overhaul` (commit "feat(views): container view configuration contract").

Staged on review, the same day: grouping by a multi-select, checkbox, completion, priority or
assignee is decided as written below, but lands with the web board work in a later slice, because
the web board cannot draw those groups yet. Until then `PropertyTypes.CanGroupBy`, its TypeScript
twin `canGroupBy`, the structure catalog and the pet's catalogs stay at single select. Exports
(`packages/view-render`) group by the raw stored value until they learn the wider types.

documents.title: ADR-0056: A lock hides the titles under it

properties.recorded_status:
Accepted by the owner, 2026-10-01, as part of the suggestions work on `feature/suggestions`.
ADR-0055 is reserved for the server-side container query that ADR-0054 names; this record takes the
next free number.

documents.title: ADR-0057: Model-free suggestions

properties.recorded_status:
Accepted by the owner, 2026-10-01, with [SEC] approval to merge `feature/suggestions` once its
review fixes verify. Amends ADR-0053 (a second derived holder of body content).

documents.title: ADR-0058: Item protections, and calendar items managed from settings

properties.recorded_status:
Proposed 2026-10-04. Built and committed on `main` at the owner's direction; [SEC] approval pending.
Amends ADR-0052 (calendar sync) and notes one consequence for ADR-0056 (locks).

documents.title: ADR-0059: A speech role for recording, transcription, voices and dictation

properties.recorded_status:
Proposed 2026-10-05. Built on `main` in `deb29b68` (2026-10-05), with the `speech-worker` and
`speech-worker-l4t` CI images following in `79de973a`. The open items below (host benchmark,
voice choice) and the [SEC] approval are not recorded as done.
Takes up the audio half of the "transcoding and general binary indexing" decision that
ADR-0047 left open, and adds a role and a queue to ADR-0048's worker topology.

documents.title: ADR-0060: Ad-hoc workspace queries and aggregates

properties.recorded_status:
Proposed 2026-10-09 with `feature/core-query`; owner acceptance pending. Supersedes two
decisions of the saved-query ADR (0039, no longer kept in this tree): "the client never sends
rules" and "rules are AND only".

ADR-0061: Mermaid semantic editing and shared components

properties.recorded_status:
Proposed 2026-10-09, local and uncommitted. The owner requires individual shape
editing and standard Mermaid export for every diagram family, with shared
components across separate diagrams. Source-only editing, image fallbacks and
Nix-only export extensions do not satisfy that requirement.
